prompt: A resident will be out all day Monday. The only window to be cleaned faces the courtyard. What should the resident do?
promptZh: 一位住戶星期一整天外出，唯一要清潔的窗戶面向中庭。住戶應怎麼做？

options.text: Close the window by eight without making a separate appointment.
options.zh: 早上八點前關窗，不必另行預約。
options.whyZh: 中庭窗不必有人在家，早上八點前關好即可。

options.text: Leave a key so the crew can close the window
options.zh: 留下鑰匙，讓清潔人員關窗
options.whyZh: 不能使用留在辦公室的備用鑰匙，且關窗是住戶應做的。

options.text: Ask for a second courtyard appointment
options.zh: 要求另排一次中庭清潔
options.whyZh: 住戶無須在場，不必改約。

options.text: Sign up for a balcony visit
options.whyZh: 窗戶朝中庭，不適用陽台清潔安排。

explanationZh: 中庭窗不必有人在家，早上八點前關好即可。
evidence: You don't have to be home for a courtyard window. Please close it by eight in the morning.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: You don't have to be home for a courtyard window. Please close it by eight in the morning.

vocabulary.note: 這類窗戶可由中庭清潔，住戶不用在家。
